exposure: reasons for antenatal admissions in labor room before term
outcome: maternal outcomes (vaginal delivery, caesarean section, LAMA, discharge/referral)
cohort: Pregnant female patients admitted to Nalanda Medical College and Hospital (NMCH, LRE) before 37 completed weeks of gestation with a hospital stay longer than 48 hours before delivery.
finding: The study found that while the average duration of antenatal stay before childbirth is less than 48 hours, some admissions extend up to 14-15 days, with various feto-maternal outcomes and hospital-acquired complications such as infections identified.
mod_finding: The study reported outcomes related to mode of birth, with live births occurring via vaginal delivery (23), IUD (3), VBAC (1), and caesarean section (22), and IUD (1), alongside other outcomes like LAMA (15) and discharge/referral (23).
